convertibility_reason: Uses iCustom to load RVIDiff custom indicator, and depends on external .mqh libraries (TradeAlgorithms.mqh, SmoothAlgorithms.mqh) for trading logic, money management, and smoothing algorithms. Position sizing uses custom MarginMode enum from TradeAlgorithms.mqh.

derived_values.name: TimeShiftSec - seconds per indicator timeframe bar
derived_values.used_by: UpSignalTime and DnSignalTime calculation for position open timing

derived_values.name: min_rates_total - minimum bars required for indicator calculation

other_exits: Long closed when RVIDiff[1]>RVIDiff[2] (bearish signal) and BuyPosClose is true
Short closed when RVIDiff[1]<RVIDiff[2] (bullish signal) and SellPosClose is true

position_sizing.conditional_logic: MMMode enum selects sizing method: FREEMARGIN=fraction of free margin, BALANCE=fraction of balance, LOSSFREEMARGIN=fraction of free margin minus loss, LOSSBALANCE=fraction of balance minus loss, LOT=fixed lot size. Positive MM=fraction, MM=0.1 with LOT mode means fixed 0.1 lots.

custom_logic_notes: Entry requires Value[0]>=Value[1] for longs (current bar RVI not declining from previous) and Value[0]<=Value[1] for shorts (current bar RVI not rising from previous), in addition to the crossover of bars [1] vs [2]. The crossover is on bars offset by SignalBar (default=1), so actual comparison is between indicator buffer at shift SignalBar+1 and SignalBar+2. When SignalBar=0, signals are evaluated on every tick without new-bar guard. The signal time is set to the last bar datetime plus one timeframe period, effectively targeting next bar open. BuyPosOpen/SellPosOpen/SellPosClose/BuyPosClose input booleans gate whether each direction's open/close is active.
python_conversion_notes: The RVIDiff custom indicator must be reimplemented in Python. It uses the SmoothAlgorithms.mqh library (T3 smoothing by default). The RVI calculation with T3 smoothing needs to be ported. The TradeAlgorithms.mqh functions (BuyPositionOpen, SellPositionOpen, BuyPositionClose, SellPositionClose, GlobalVariableDel_) encapsulate position management with margin-based sizing and must be reimplemented. The MarginMode enum with 5 sizing modes needs careful translation. Entry signals use a 3-bar lookback of the RVIDiff buffer at offsets [SignalBar, SignalBar+1, SignalBar+2]. Signal time is constructed from SERIES_LASTBAR_DATE + TimeShiftSec for order timing. New bar detection uses the CIsNewBar class from TradeAlgorithms.mqh.
